sites.name: northgate-clinic
sites.role: the clinic (publisher); a repository whose site/ folder is served

sites.name: northgate-mirror
sites.role: the attacker's address: a parked page until the forgery act puts a mirror of the clinic there

extras.name: harbour-pharmacy
extras.role: the pharmacy, a verifier and not a site: its plumbline.trust.json (empty at the start) and its notes

acts.signed: The clinic's site signed with key A (keys/clinic-a, a throwaway key made by keygen) for the clinic's origin, key A's record published at .well-known/plumbline-key.json; the pharmacy's trust file is empty. Played by up.
acts.tamper: One signed file on the clinic's site is edited after signing: the out-of-hours number in northgate_clinic.network.json changes.
acts.forgery: The mirror serves a copy of the clinic's agent files with altered instructions, with key A's record, validly signed with key A for the CLINIC's origin (the attacker has the stolen key file).
acts.forgery-own-origin: The thief re-signs the mirror (the forgery's altered files) with the stolen key A for the MIRROR's own origin, not the clinic's. Needs forgery first; refused once attacker-rotates has been played. Added after run 2026-11-18-first-five.
acts.expire: The clinic is signed again with key A, dated 31 days ago with a 30-day lifetime, so its expiresAt is one day past. Refused when the clinic is no longer signed by key A, or key A is revoked there.
acts.attacker-rotates: The mirror publishes plumbline-rotation.json from key A to the attacker's own key (keys/attacker), publishes that key's record and is signed with it. Needs forgery first.
